issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation reverses the logical order of the Greek clauses. The Greek structure is: [Revealed by prophetic writings] -> [Known to all nations] -> [For obedience of faith]. The Vietnamese places 'known to all nations' before the purpose clause, but more importantly, it renders 'εις υπακοην πιστεως' (into/for obedience of faith) as 'để đem họ đến sự vâng phục của đức tin' (to bring them to the obedience of faith). While close, the Greek 'εις' functions as a goal/result of the revealing/knowing process. The Vietnamese 'đem họ đến' (bring them to) adds a causative action ('bring') not present in the Greek, which simply states the purpose/destination of the revelation.
